messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2026-02-10] standup/boreal/2026-02-10: Team Boreal on-call swapped this morning. Marcus Oyelaran carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2025-10-16] standup/cinder/2025-10-16: The Cinder team has moved to the third floor.
- [2025-10-24] standup/cinder/2025-10-24: Diego has the Cinder pager this cycle, taking over from Yuki.
- [2025-02-27] standup/cinder/2025-02-27: Yuki has the Cinder pager this cycle, taking over from Diego.
- [2026-02-10] standup/boreal/2026-02-10-2: Team Boreal noticed that the indexer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners.
- [2025-01-09] standup/cinder/2025-01-09: Diego is on call for Cinder to start the year.
- [2025-02-12] standup/atlas/2025-02-12: On-call rotation: Priya is primary for the Atlas team starting today; Tomasz is off rotation.
- [2025-02-18] standup/ember/2025-02-18: Per the change policy, auth-gateway deploys on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.
- [2025-10-13] handover/2025-10-13-ledger: From today the pager for the ledger rings Cinder, not team Atlas. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-04-14] standup/cinder/2025-04-14: The catalog service calls the resizer for thumbnails, so treat the resizer as a hard dependency of the catalog service.
- [2025-12-29] standup/cinder/2025-12-29: Reminder: auth-gateway deploys only on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.
- [2026-03-03] standup/cinder/2026-03-03: The auth gateway deploy window (unchanged): on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.
- [2025-01-10] standup/ember/2025-01-10: The Ember team is a one-person team at the moment: Oskar.
- [2025-12-10] standup/dune/2025-12-10: Tomasz Nowak has the Dune pager this cycle, taking over from Farah.
- [2025-10-15] standup/dune/2025-10-15: Farah has the Dune pager this cycle, taking over from Tomasz Nowak.
- [2025-09-03] standup/cinder/2025-09-03: New deploy window for the product catalog: on weekdays between 08:00 and 10:00 UTC, never on Fridays. Forget the previous Mon-Thu 09:00-17:00 UTC slot.
- [2025-10-15] standup/atlas/2025-10-15: Team Atlas noticed that the image resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners.
- [2025-02-06] standup/ember/2025-02-06-2: Team Ember now does pairing on every production change.
- [2025-04-02] standup/ember/2025-04-02: Changes to the billing API need a rollback plan attached to the pull request.
- [2025-02-11] standup/boreal/2025-02-11-2: If the bus is down, the webhooks service is down: it relies on it for outbound events.
- [2025-02-11] standup/boreal/2025-02-11: If the event bus is down, the notification service is down: it relies on it for delivery events.
- [2025-02-12] standup/boreal/2025-02-12: Rotation day for the Boreal team: Lena hands the pager to Marcus.
- [2025-02-11] standup/atlas/2025-02-11: Reminder that the billing API only ships on weekdays after 15:00 UTC.
- [2025-01-13] standup/dune/2025-01-13: First on-call rotation for the Dune team goes to Farah.
- [2025-01-09] standup/atlas/2025-01-09: First on-call rotation for team Atlas goes to Tomasz.
- [2025-02-07] standup/ember/2025-02-07: Dependency map update: scheduler needs the feature flag service (per-job kill switches).
- [2025-02-06] standup/ember/2025-02-06: Deploys to the job scheduler happen on Tuesdays between 13:00 and 15:00 UTC and at no other time.
- [2026-02-03] standup/atlas/2026-02-03: The Atlas team now does a no-deploy Friday.
- [2025-01-14] standup/ember/2025-01-14: Oskar takes the first the Ember team on-call shift of the year.
- [2025-02-21] standup/boreal/2025-02-21-2: Boreal noticed that the ledger service's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change and pinged the owners.
- [2025-09-04] standup/dune/2025-09-04: Tomasz Nowak picked up the Dune on-call shift from Farah today.
- [2025-02-21] standup/boreal/2025-02-21: Decision: the notifier will retry failed pushes three times with exponential backoff, because the flat one-second retry was hammering the push provider during its outages.
- [2025-05-13] standup/atlas/2025-05-13: The Atlas team on-call swapped this morning. Priya carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2025-05-07] standup/boreal/2025-05-07: Marcus Oyelaran picked up the Boreal on-call shift from Lena Fischer today.
- [2026-03-02] standup/ember/2026-03-02: Reminder from the Ember team: page Oskar Lind for anything this cycle, not Diego.
- [2025-01-17] standup/cinder/2025-01-17-2: For the record, the indexer is owned by Cinder.
- [2025-01-17] standup/cinder/2025-01-17: Team Cinder owns the product catalog.
- [2025-09-02] standup/atlas/2025-09-02: Decided in today's standup: clients will cache feature-flags evaluations for 30 seconds, since feature-flags saw 40,000 requests per second at peak and most of them were identical.

Question: Who was on call for Cinder on 2025-02-10?
